map.算法：绝对温度 TK = 温度+273.15；Larson-Miller 参数: Algorithm: absolute temperature TK = temperature + 273.15; Larson-Miller parameter LMP = A minus 5000 times log10(stress), A is the material constant; from LMP = TK times (log10 t + C) solve log10 t = LMP / TK minus C, rupture time t = 10 to the power of (LMP / TK minus C) (h); steady-state creep rate epsilon dot = 1e-12 times stress to the 5 times exp(minus 280000 / (8.314 times TK)) (1/h, stress exponent n = 5, activation energy Q = 280 kJ/mol); rupture strain = epsilon dot times t; creep threshold temperature = melting point times 0.4 minus 273.15 (C), below the threshold creep is negligible.
map.例：Cr-Mo 钢（熔点 1510℃、C=20、A=30000）、550℃、10: Example: Cr-Mo steel (melting point 1510 C, C = 20, A = 30000), 550 C, 100 MPa gives TK 823.15 K, LMP 20000, log10 t = 4.2969, rupture time 19811 h (2.26 years), creep threshold 330.9 C, evaluated as moderate creep life, use by design life. Heating to 600 C, stress 120 MPa gives LMP 19604.1, log10 t = 2.4521, rupture time drops sharply to 283 h, must reduce condition or switch to nickel-based alloy.
map.Larson-Miller 参数 C 通常取多少？: What value does the Larson-Miller parameter C usually take?
map.对多数铁基耐热钢 C≈20（本工具默认值），镍基合金常取 22 左右；A 由材料: For most ferritic heat-resistant steels C is about 20 (the tool default), nickel-based alloys often take about 22; A is regressed from material creep rupture strength tests, Cr-Mo steel about 30000, nickel-based alloy can reach 50000, material manual or manufacturer data should be preferred.
map.为什么蠕变门槛取熔点的 40%？: Why is the creep threshold taken at 40% of the melting point?
map.金属发生显著蠕变的最低温度约为熔点（热力学温度）的 0.3~0.4 倍，工程中常: The minimum temperature for significant metal creep is about 0.3 to 0.4 times the (thermodynamic) melting point temperature; engineering often uses 0.4 times as the criterion; below this temperature the creep rate is very small and static strength design can be used.
